# Bidon - Open Source Ad Mediation

> SDK integration guides, ad format references, and server setup docs for the Bidon open-source ad mediation platform. Covers Android, iOS, Unity SDKs and mediation adapters for AppLovin MAX and LevelPlay.

Documentation for the Bidon open-source ad mediation platform.

Sections:
- SDK Integration: Android, iOS, and Unity SDK setup, ad formats, and advanced features
- Server: Self-hosted deployment, S3 export, reporting and inventory APIs
- Monetization: Getting started with Bidon monetization
- AppLovin MAX: Bidon adapter integration with MAX mediation
- LevelPlay: Bidon adapter integration with LevelPlay mediation
